example.title: Georgia DOT Bridge No. 151-00144-X-00055S, Springdale Road over Little Cotton Indian Creek

brief: Small riveted steel Warren pony truss with verticals, 1930, a single 41 ft span 18 ft wide, on masonry rubble abutments with steel intermediate piles and caps, steel beams and a timber plank deck. Low trusses with a plain angle top rail; carries a gravel county road through pine woods and pasture over a narrow muddy creek. (Inventory span is 0 m, so this sits right beside SMALL-01 on the same creek; model it as the second, shorter crossing.)

traits.abutments: rubble masonry with steel pile bents
